status: Optional local CUDA backend, explicitly selected through wime-neural-program.

inference.kv_cache: Rust CPU caches the conditioning prefix; CUDA recomputes the full prompt/draft.

comparison.procedure: Same ordered 120 held-out samples (20 per category) and 116 diagnostic cases. Sequential isolated worker runs; zero debounce; first composition reported separately. Timers/output serviced with 1 ms waits. Includes actual Emacs dictionary/prefix search, JSON IPC and model inference. The normal 40 ms debounce is excluded. GPU comparison uses the first 236 rows of gpu_result.

full_integration.note: Last 4864 rows of gpu_result, after the 236-row comparison; GPU worker remains warm. Original predictions and domain accuracy are preserved.

resources.note: Measured by nvidia-smi and /proc after a live request. RSS includes shared Python/PyTorch libraries. This is a host Python dependency, not bundled into the Rust executable.

validation.malformed_input: worker exits with sanitized stderr, without echoing request text
validation.no_cuda: worker exits; actual Emacs fallback preserves original candidates and buffer

limitations: Timings describe this NVIDIA GPU and host; other hardware was not measured.
Process cold start includes Python/model/CUDA initialization but does not simulate an uncached OS page cache or reboot.
The 235-sample warm comparison is paired; the larger 4864-case GPU timing has a different input distribution and must not be compared directly with the 235-case CPU percentile.
The CPU is the existing native Rust backend, not PyTorch CPU.
GPU mode supports conditional verify only. Unconditional rerank is intentionally not executed.
All previous automatic-pinyin, pretraining-overlap, and diagnostic-set limitations remain.
